description: Defines type traits and compatibility checks for containers and spans within the ocuduvec namespace, including template utilities for extracting types and verifying span compatibility with integral, arithmetic, and complex types.

classes.name: get_first_type_in_pack
classes.description: Extracts the first type from a parameter pack.

classes.name: value_type_of_container
classes.description: Determines the value type of a container template.

classes.name: value_type_of_impl
classes.description: Implements type deduction for various container types.

methods.name: remove_cvref_t
methods.description: Removes const, volatile qualifiers and references from a type.

methods.name: value_type_of_t
methods.description: Alias for the deduced value type of a container.

methods.name: is_integral_span_compatible
methods.description: Checks if a type T is compatible with a span of integral types.

methods.name: is_arithmetic_span_compatible
methods.description: Checks if a type T is compatible with a span of arithmetic types.

methods.name: is_complex_span_compatible
methods.description: Checks if a type T is compatible with a span of complex floating point types.

methods.name: is_span_compatible
